notes.title: March 8 Update.
notes.content: We've made a small adjustment to the resolution that will impact anyone installing the game from this point forward. Some players were experiencing the game in an suboptimal format. We've implemented a quick fix and are currently working on a more permanent solution for the issue.

tags.bug: Some players were experiencing the game in an suboptimal format.

notes.title: Feb. 16 Update
notes.content:
Enhanced Speed Control: We've replaced the speed altering buttons with a slider, providing you with more precise control over your movements. Now, you can fine-tune your speed to match your skill level and gameplay preferences effortlessly.

Bug Fix: We've addressed a critical issue that was causing a softlock in Level 16. You can now progress through the level smoothly without encountering any unexpected interruptions.

notes.title: Feb 15 update.
notes.content:
Addressed a soft lock problem occurring post-level victory, where no further actions would ensue. Note: Potential remnants of this issue may persist in minor instances.

Resolved a glitch related to the flame effect, where fire streaks erroneously appeared between units despite no actual activity taking place.

notes.title: Feb 9th Update.
notes.content:
We're thrilled to introduce the Simulation Room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826788/ee75a02aa0a98b9b9908f21d45a7edcd8bc110a2.png[/img]

What is it?
The Simulation Room is your virtual playground for testing strategies. Spawn any enemy unit, build towers, and refine your tactics without consequences.

Simply navigate to the Simulation Room from the new button on the War Room table!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826788/d0720918cd8ca3d70f9f322b58dc678e4d3e5377.png[/img]


Secondly, an essential addition is the inclusion of a proper ending video/scene. A short few sentences to cap off the "storyline".


Stay tuned for more updates as we expand this exciting feature based on your feedback.

tags.feature: We're thrilled to introduce the Simulation Room.
Secondly, an essential addition is the inclusion of a proper ending video/scene.

notes.title: Small dificulty update.
notes.content: Small difficulty update to make Easy and Medium modes into slightly more challenging even for new players.

tags.balance_change: - Easy and Medium modes have been made slightly more challenging.
- Adjusted enemy AI to provide a more engaging experience on lower difficulties.

notes.title: Small update - Jan 27/24
notes.content:
Tweaked the way air support locks onto targets, making it way less picky and more user-friendly.

Gave the first few levels a facelift, so now the difficulty eases in for newcomers, letting them get the hang of things without feeling overwhelmed.

Beefed up the V12 unit by slapping on three extra rockets – because let's be real, one just wasn't cutting it.

Spruced up some textures on our soldier buddies; they were looking a bit meh, but now they're rocking a more polished and snazzy appearance.
